name: ZCA_UA_CLICK_HISTORY
description: Table to store the users Navigational Click Events

columns.name: CLICK_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Primary Key of Click History Data table

columns.name: CLICK_HISTORY_DATE
columns.description: DateTime when the Click Event is recorded

columns.name: CH_USERNAME
columns.description: User associated with the Click Event

columns.name: CLICK_HISTORY_ECID
columns.description: Execution ContextId associated with the Click Event

columns.name: CH_RENDERER_TYPE
columns.description: Click Renderer Type

columns.name: CH_COMPONENT_TYPE
columns.description: Click Component Type

columns.name: CH_APPLICATION_NAME
columns.description: Application Name that handled the Click Event

columns.name: CH_DIAG_SESSION_ID
columns.description: Diagnostic SessionId associated with the Click Event

columns.name: CH_EVENT_COMP_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Click Event's Component Display Name

columns.name: CH_EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: Click Event Type

columns.name: CH_EVENT_WINDOW_ID
columns.description: Click Event Window Id

columns.name: CH_EVENT_VIEW_ID
columns.description: Click Event Window Id

columns.name: CH_EVENT_COMP_FAMILY
columns.description: Click Event Component Family

columns.name: CH_REGION_VIEW_NAME
columns.description: Click Region View Name

columns.name: CH_PARENT_CONTEXT_ID
columns.description: Click Parent Context Id

columns.name: CH_REGION_VIEW_ID
columns.description: Click Event Region View Id

columns.name: CH_EVENT_COMP_CLIENT_ID
columns.description: Click Event Component ID

columns.name: CH_EVENT_RENDER_TIME
columns.description: Click Event UI Rendering Time

columns.name: CH_EVENT_TOTAL_TIME
columns.description: Click Event Total Time

columns.name: CH_SERVER_TIME
columns.description: Server Time represents time taken on the server side. IT is obtained by getting the difference between Total Event Time ( CH_EVENT_TOTAL_TIME ) and  the UI rendering time ( CH_EVENT_RENDER_TIME )

columns.name: CH_CLICK_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to the Click History Mapping Table

columns.name: CH_CLICK_TIME_SPENT
columns.description: CH_CLICK_TIME_SPENT shows how much time user spent on this click flow, as identified by the click mapping ID, measured in seconds.

columns.name: CLICK_USER_REGION
columns.description: User's Geographic Region associated with the click event

columns.name: CLICK_CHANNEL
columns.description: Channel associated with the User Clicks - WEB, MOBILE, OUTLOOK, etc

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
